scenario: Reconcile two orders for the same SKU. A ordered ten and cancelled two; six shipped and four are delivery-confirmed. B ordered eight; all eight shipped and are delivery-confirmed.

messages.text: Reconcile two orders for the same SKU. A ordered ten and cancelled two; six shipped and four are delivery-confirmed. B ordered eight; all eight shipped and are delivery-confirmed.

Using the synthetic snapshot in fixtures/fulfillment-input.example.json: ORDER-A / ITEM-1 has 8 EA net ordered, 6 departed and 4 delivery-confirmed. That leaves 2 without departure evidence and 2 departed without delivery confirmation. ORDER-B / ITEM-1 has 8 departed and 8 delivery-confirmed; its totals cannot offset A.
Make the result useful in an ordinary chat client and leave a durable handoff.

The example handoff records ORDERS r2, SHIPMENTS r1 and DELIVERIES r1, captured at 16:00Z, with a 17:00Z cutoff on 2026-10-04. COORDINATOR-LEE must check A's missing evidence and review customer wording. A is past its supplied promise without full delivery evidence; B's promise is unknown. Nothing was shipped, changed or sent by this Claw.

report.summary: A has two not shipped and two shipped without delivery confirmation; B has no outstanding quantity. Aggregate totals do not erase A's exception, and no shipment or customer contact is performed.
